🔴🟣 The symbolism of red and purple in identifying the antichrist: https://youtu.be/pRj1kS3_eB0
✋ What is the mark of the beast: https://youtu.be/st2S0xis-Ck
🎙️ Mark of the beast and antichrist podcast: https://youtu.be/u_ohSCqVm98
🔥 The Baal origins of 666: https://youtu.be/-3hjsw446H0
🎞️ Revelation: The Bride, the Beast, and Babylon documentary: https://youtu.be/vDKG_WFLUi4?si=OQkWTVjzxTDHVKzk
🇺🇸 USA in Bible prophecy: https://youtu.be/o9AiiVzw0Xw

‼️ Free Great Controversy book: https://thegreatcontroversy.org 
📖 Study Bible prophecy with our free online Bible school: lls.tv/bibleschool

📅 Project 2025 video: https://youtu.be/zHD1SUIJyyY?si=YfgWGdfU2tA49j7g

✝️ Sabbath and Sunday in the Bible: https://www.sabbathtruth.com
😮 Quotations from the Roman Catholic Church about changing Sabbath to Sunday: https://www.sabbathtruth.com/sabbath-history/denominational-statements-on-the-sabbath/id/catholic
📅 History of how the Sabbath changed to Sunday episode 1: https://youtu.be/t0PPTfV4kPw
📅 History of how the Sabbath changed to Sunday episode 2: https://youtu.be/tJpMQKU6el8

📖Also, check out these following verses to ponder on:
- "If you love Me, keep My commandments." (John 14:15; Jesus' words)
- “Do not think that I came to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I did not come to destroy but to fulfill. For assuredly, I say to you, till heaven and earth pass away, one jot or one tittle will by no means pass from the law till all is fulfilled." (Matthew 5:17-18; Jesus' words)
- Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
- "And he (Jesus) came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read." Luke 4:16
- Sabbath kept in heaven: "For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain. And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord." (Isaiah 66:22-23)
- Doesn't Colossians 2:14 wipe out the weekly Sabbath? No, it doesn't. Read full answer here: https://www.sabbathtruth.com/faq/frequently-asked-questions/ans/id/929/t/doesn-t-colossians-2-14-wipe-out-the-weekly-sabbath-
- Aren't we under grace now and no longer have to keep the law? No, God's commandments are everlasting (see verses above). Therefore, that thought does not stand. So how do we explain Romans 6:14-15? Check out the full answer here: https://www.sabbathtruth.com/faq/frequently-asked-questions/ans/id/1019/t/are-we-still-under-the-law-
- Doesn't 1 Corinthians 16:1-3 prove the Sabbath was changed? No, it doesn't. Read full answer here: https://www.sabbathtruth.com/faq/frequently-asked-questions/ans/id/1044/t/doesn-t-1-corinthians-16-prove-the-sabbath-was-changed-
- Is it really necessary to go to church on Sabbath? https://www.sabbathtruth.com/faq/frequently-asked-questions/ans/id/1678/t/is-it-necessary-to-go-to-church-on-the-sabbath-
